reviews.text:
I arrived at the clinic on time for my appointment, but I was made to wait for a full 45 minutes.

The waiting area was filled with pet cages, and there was hardly any place to sit while holding my dog, so I had to stand the entire time.

There were no staff members at the reception desk, so I had no way to inquire about the waiting time. Even when I spoke to them, no one explained the situation.

The examination and treatment itself were fine, but the management of appointment times is extremely sloppy.

I can understand a short wait of 10-15 minutes. However, waiting 45 minutes when I had an appointment is far too long.

If there is an expectation of long waits due to congestion, it is only natural to call in advance before coming to the clinic.

Suddenly making us wait for such a long time on the day of the appointment is a waste of time for both the owner and the pet.

My pet was also stressed and tired from waiting for such a long time.

If this situation continues, I would not consider returning for a follow-up visit. I strongly hope for improvements to the appointment system and reception service.

As this is my first time raising a puppy, I have many anxieties, but despite their busy schedules, they have kindly responded to my inquiries via LINE and other means. They have also thoughtfully answered my questions, and thanks to this hospital, I am able to enjoy raising my puppy rather than feel anxious, for which I am very grateful.

Their judgment is terrible. They contact you when you've almost forgotten about it, so everything is done after the fact. I can't understand what the staff are saying; being born in Tokyo, I don't understand it at all (sorry).
Adding the Ezo deer jerky they sell here to the feed after grinding it in a mill improves the nutritional balance.
However, they don't give that kind of guidance. You have to do it yourself.

I can only think the doctor is bad at prescribing (compared to those in the animal husbandry university system).
It's cheap, but it's a hassle.

My cat is regularly cared for at this clinic.

They are always very kind and attentive.

There are several animal hospitals near my home, and although this one is a bit further away, I feel most comfortable taking my cat there.

We always rely on your clinic for our dog's skin care and grooming needs.

We were extremely grateful that you saw our dog even without an appointment when he accidentally ingested something.

You always explain things so thoroughly, and our whole family feels completely at ease entrusting our dog to your care.

We understand you operate seven days a week, but please take care of yourselves and your health.

We've been using your services for our regular checkups.

The doctor is very kind to our cats, provides thorough explanations each time, and listens attentively to our concerns.

We feel very reassured knowing that you take ample time to examine our cats carefully.

Also, the fact that you're open 365 days a year is incredibly reassuring. It's very comforting to know that we have someone we can rely on in emergencies.

Thank you for your assistance during an emergency, even at night.

We look forward to continuing to use your services.

The doctor is always dedicated and will even help with urgent consultations.

I drive about 30 minutes to get there, but it's worth it, and I can't imagine going to any other hospital.

The staff are also kind and I highly recommend them!

Our Siberian cat, who becomes aggressive at vet visits, relies heavily on this clinic as his regular veterinarian.

They provide optimal care, taking his personality into consideration.

When he suddenly developed urinary stones on January 1st, they were open 24/7, which was a real lifesaver.

They are open until 7 PM on weekdays and weekends, making it a reliable clinic to rush to when your pet suddenly becomes ill.

It's rare to find a clinic that accepts patients on weekends, holidays, and long weekends, so it's incredibly valuable for cat and dog owners in the Setagaya area and surrounding neighborhoods. I highly recommend it as your regular vet!

Both consultations and grooming services are transparent and reasonably priced, just as described on their website, making it easy to continue visiting.

We'll continue to rely on them!

My dog ​​is being looked after here.
When I have any questions about the treatment or medication, they take the time to explain them clearly and patiently, which makes me feel at ease.
It seems they don't do any physical examinations other than weight measurement.
It's best to ask them to look at any areas that concern you, such as the inside of the dog's mouth, eyes, ears or joints.
They are happy to examine the dog.
This is an extremely valuable hospital that is open 365 days a year and also handles emergencies outside of opening hours.

I'm asking for a checkup for my cat.
While it's unusual, the clinic is open 365 days a year, which is very appreciated and reassuring for me as a patient. They're open all year round, even over the New Year holidays.
I'm a little concerned about the quiet atmosphere inside the clinic, but they have a wide variety of pet food available, and I don't think the prices are high compared to other hospitals. I can also pay with PayPay and Setagaya Pay.
The doctor I had before my current hospital was a bit unpleasant and I didn't like him, so I went to a different hospital as my primary care doctor, but I think Dr. Akagi is a good doctor. (I've come to think this after going there a few times.)
I hope he continues to be careful not to damage his health.
Thank you as always.

My dog ​​swallowed a whole chicken wing. It was outside of clinic hours, so I didn't know what to do and contacted them on a gamble.
I can't express how much it helped me when the doctor said to me kindly, "It's okay, please come right away."
After the appointment, we took an X-ray, and based on the results, he explained the treatment options and possible risks in a very clear and concise manner.
At the doctor's suggestion, we decided to wait until the next day to see how things went. At the follow-up appointment the following day, the wing had progressed and the bone did not show up on the X-ray, so I was truly relieved to hear that the dog was fine.
I am truly grateful for his calm judgment and his consideration of my concerns as an owner.
I felt that this was a trustworthy doctor and veterinary hospital.

I received very thorough advice via LINE, and the doctor was wonderful; I felt completely at ease during my examination.

The nurses were also very kind, making this a very reassuring hospital.

Although other hospitals had deemed surgery difficult for my bladder and urethral stones, this hospital kindly provided treatment despite it being an emergency.

The surgery was successful, and I am relieved that my postoperative recovery is going smoothly.

I am deeply grateful for the life-saving treatment. Thank you very much.

[Warning] I visited this hospital for life-threatening symptoms, but received extremely dishonest treatment.

Due to the extremely inappropriate treatment I received at this hospital, I am providing a detailed report of the events of that day to prevent similar incidents from happening again.

Yesterday (December 9, 2025), my cat began vomiting and spitting up blood around noon, and showed no improvement by nightfall. Therefore, I searched for the nearest animal hospital the following morning and chose this one. Because it was nearby and had high ratings and reviews, I made an appointment through their online reservation form.

Today (December 10), I arrived at the reception desk exactly at my appointment time of 9:00 AM. However, there was no one at the reception desk, and even after waiting in the waiting room for more than 10 minutes, no staff appeared. I called out towards the back, but received no response. I called the landline phone, and it rang from the back, but no one answered immediately.

After ringing the phone about eight times, a doctor, presumably on duty, finally answered, and I explained that I had an appointment for 9:00 AM and was waiting at the reception desk. Afterward, I felt a great sense of unease when the doctor emerged from the back. His hair was disheveled, his eyes were only half-open, and it was clear he had just woken up. He stumbled along, his voice weak, and only instructed me to fill out the questionnaire, completely ignoring my beloved cat in its carrier, before returning to the back.

It was 9:15 AM at this point. I had serious concerns about the treatment, but I was worried about my cat and wanted her examined as quickly as possible, so I silently filled out the questionnaire and waited. I had heard that vomiting blood in cats is a serious emergency and can become critical, so I had clearly stated the symptoms on the reservation form, and they should have been aware of it beforehand. However, the doctor showed no interest in my cat's condition, didn't say anything, and didn't even glance at her.

Even after filling out the questionnaire, I was left alone for another 10 minutes or more without any explanation, and even at 9:35 AM, there was still no explanation. I waited anxiously, searching for other clinics, but there was still no word. After waiting an additional 5 minutes, for a total of 40 minutes, without any response, I loudly called for a doctor, demanded the return of the medical questionnaire containing my personal information, and decided to discharge my pet.

At that time, the doctor on duty gave the following explanation:

"I was waiting in the back because I thought you would just come into the examination room on your own after you finished filling out the questionnaire."

This is an explanation that is completely unacceptable for a medical institution.

The above is an honest and unexaggerated account of the treatment we received at this hospital that day.

I have much more to say, but this doctor on duty severely lacks the most important quality for a medical professional entrusted with the lives of animals: "a respect for life."

Perhaps, caught up in the demands of business management, veterinary medicine has become merely a routine task, causing them to lose sight of what should be most important.

While there are many positive reviews, the situation of all being 5 stars is extremely rare, raising doubts about its reliability.

You respond enthusiastically to positive reviews, but how will you respond to your first negative review?

Incidentally, after that, I rushed to another nearby animal hospital and explained the symptoms, and even though I didn't have an appointment, they recognized the urgency and examined my pet promptly.

I feel fortunate to have such a wonderful clinic nearby.
They have no closing days, so I can get treatment for sudden accidents or illnesses, and being able to make reservations and consultations via LINE is incredibly helpful.
Above all, the doctor and staff are all kind and provide excellent service.

Recently, I've been having my dog ​​groomed here, and because it's medical grooming, I feel at ease knowing I can consult with the doctor about any minor skin or ear issues.
The groomers are highly skilled, fast, and efficient, yet the prices are reasonable, and it's easy to make reservations—it's perfect!
I also enjoy receiving photos via LINE and uploading them to Instagram each time.

I hope to continue using their services for many years to come.

I had my 10-year-old golden retriever spayed. I missed the opportunity to have him spayed when he was younger, and I had heard that older dogs are more susceptible to surgery, including anesthesia, so I was hesitant to have him undergo the surgery. However, Dr. Akagi, the director of the clinic, is also well-versed in anesthesia, so I felt at ease and left the surgery in his care.
He has gained weight as he has aged, so I imagine the surgery was difficult.
Thank you so much, Dr. Akagi.
I also appreciate your shampooing, and thank you for always keeping him so clean.
The nurses and groomers are all so kind and wonderful.
I would like to continue to have you treat him.
Thank you very much.

My usual vet was closed for the long weekend, and I was in a bind.

This vet seems to be open every day, and it appears the doctor sees patients alone. I was relieved to hear that I can always contact the head vet.

I hadn't been there since my kitten was a kitten, but the doctor and nurses were incredibly kind and gave my cat a thorough examination. Thanks to them, it didn't turn into anything serious. Thank you so much.

My beloved cat was injured, and I took her in for an examination. The doctor explained everything very carefully, which put my mind at ease as a pet owner. I'm also grateful for the gentle treatment of my cat.

Being able to make reservations via LINE and the website is very helpful!

I hadn't found a regular vet yet due to moving, but I would like to continue using this clinic's services in the future!

The vet is very kind, and I feel at ease entrusting my dog ​​to them. When I requested a dental cleaning to remove plaque, they explained everything thoroughly, including the cost. I recommend them to my dog-owning friends.

He is a young, highly motivated, and sincere veterinarian. He treats rescue dogs and cats without discrimination, and his kind personality shines through. He is open 365 days a year, but he sometimes looks very tired, so I really hope he takes care of himself as well. This is a veterinary hospital that I would like to continue using for a long time. Thank you for your continued support.
The doctor and nurses listen carefully to what I have to say, so I feel at ease and can leave my dog ​​in their care. They always trim it so cutely. Thank you.

I felt very relieved that they responded immediately to my cat's sudden health change. 
The clinic is also very clean, so I can visit with peace of mind. 😊 …

I'm the pet owner who had an adrenal gland Eco scan done a while ago, explaining that I wanted to take it to my regular vet. Thank you so much for your prompt response, even though I came without an appointment. When I asked if you could help in case my regular vet was closed or there was an emergency, you assured me that you would coordinate with other veterinary association members, which was very reassuring for me as a pet owner. Also, when I mentioned at the reception that I had previously received trimming services at Takasakura Gaya Animal Hospital, the nurse must have looked it up, because they had my pet's medical record and said they would take a look.

I would also like to express my gratitude once again to Dr. Suzuki at Takasakura Gaya.

I couldn't make it to my regular doctor's office hours, so I consulted via LINE and was able to see a doctor that same day.

Because I have a chronic illness, I was worried about even minor things, and I think I asked a lot of irrelevant questions, but I was grateful that the doctor listened to me so attentively and carefully.

I will continue to receive treatment for my chronic illness at another hospital, but I was relieved to know that there is such a doctor nearby.

I may need your help again in the future, and I look forward to seeing you then.

I went to get a second opinion. Dr. Akagi gave me a lot of advice and was a great help! He treats everyone the same, whether they live nearby or far away, and he is a very caring doctor for animals, so I will continue to go to him in the future!

Dr. Akagi gave me a thorough explanation and examination.

I feel confident continuing my visits here.

Thank you very much!

I asked them to remove hairballs and give my cat a full health check, as he would not touch me if he was angry.
I was given an approximate cost in advance, which gave me peace of mind. I was glad that the health check revealed no major abnormalities.
I look forward to seeing you again.

Thank you for your positive feedback.

All of our staff will continue to strive for improvement.

The preliminary explanation, including the approximate cost, and the subsequent explanation of test results were all thorough and easy to understand, which put me at ease.
I would like to use your services again.
I could tell that the doctor loves dogs and cats.
The nurses were also very nice.
I took my rescue cat in for a check-up. The vet was easy to talk to and I felt comfortable discussing future plans. I look forward to continuing to work with them.
